{
  "subtype": "exploratory_data_analysis",
  "focus_variable": "resolution_efficiency",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "resolution_time_hours",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "This is essentially the operationalization of resolution efficiency itself, not an external associational variable. It restates the focus and is too fine-grained to segment on for grouped comparison."
    },
    {
      "name": "sla_met",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "A binary derived directly from resolution time versus SLA; it is another expression of efficiency/outcome rather than an independent explanatory dimension to compare efficiency against."
    },
    {
      "name": "resolution_speed_category",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "A binned version of the focus. Interpretable categories, but it IS the focus discretized, not an external variable to segment against. Also heavily imbalanced ('Very Slow' 411/500)."
    },
    {
      "name": "category_avg_resolution_hours",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "A group-level aggregate of the focus keyed to category (already present). It is a summary of the target, not an external associational variable, and is near-constant (181.43 for 406 rows)."
    },
    {
      "name": "assignment_group_avg_resolution_hours",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "Same issue: an aggregate of the focus keyed to an existing segmentation column. Near-constant dominant value; opaque restatement rather than an interpretable external segmentation."
    },
    {
      "name": "resolution_vs_category_avg",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "A residual of the focus minus its category mean. Continuous, fine-grained, and derived purely from the target; not an external variable and not a clean segmentation."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 0,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.08,
  "rationale": "The query asks how efficiency varies across category, priority, and assignment group -- segmentation dimensions that already exist in the original table. Every added column is a derivative or restatement of the focus (raw time, SLA flag, speed bins, group averages of the target, residuals). None introduces a NEW external, interpretable associational variable to group on and compare efficiency against. Several are also near-constant or too fine-grained. As a set, they fail the exploratory-analysis claim of opening informative relationships around the focus."
}
